title: podophyllum aurantiocaule subsp. furfuraceum
intro: Podophyllum aurantiocaule subsp. furfuraceum, commonly known as Himalayan mayapple or Himalayan mandrake, is a plant species belonging to the family Berberidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Podophyllum aurantiocaule subsp. furfuraceum, including podophyllotoxin and lignans, exhibit therapeutic actions such as inhibiting the growth of cancer cells, reducing inflammation, and modulating the immune system. Further research is needed to confirm the safety and efficacy of this plant for medicinal use.
